title: Kapil Enterprises Knowledge Graph — schema v1 (1.0.1)
description: Contract for docs/knowledge_graph.json (Phase 8, KG-B; Design Record KG-D1..D9 ratified 2026-07-13). The graph is the single source FOR GENERATED DOCUMENTATION only — NEVER project truth (code + T1 truth-locks stay the territory; fix-at-source; hand-edits forbidden, generated class). Serialization law (KG-D4): canonical JSON — object keys sorted, nodes sorted by id, edges sorted by (from, kind, to, source), indent 2, UTF-8, single trailing newline, ZERO wall-clock timestamps anywhere in the body. Consumers (Phase-9 generators, Phase-14 knowledge_sync, Phase-18 lifecycle) pin schema MAJOR; additive evolution = minor bump only (KG-D6); the additive-minor register lives in KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH_BUILD_LOG.md §KG-0.

schema_version.description: Semver; this schema document is 1.0.1 (patch 2026-07-13: id-regex widening only — url namespace-less hyphenated names + view closure qualnames; validator-proven, PHASE_08 dated amendment). Major is pinned by consumers; breaking change = major bump + owner approval + same-change consumer update (KG-D6).

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonical body with this field's value replaced by the empty string. The validator REFUSES a graph whose hash does not match (hand-edit guard, KG-D7).

git_head.description: HEAD at build time — changes only when inputs change; NOT a timestamp.

census.description: KG-A instrument totals at build time — the completeness-floor denominators (invariant 8): per-kind node counts must be >= these.

nodes.description: Sorted by id (KG-D4). ID uniqueness = invariant 1 (validator-enforced; JSON Schema cannot express it).

edges.description: Sorted by (from, kind, to, source). Referential integrity (every endpoint exists) = invariant 2, validator-enforced.

label.description: Human-readable display name. Ownership semantics (KG-D7): every attribute value is DERIVED from its declared source; the graph owns nothing.

anchors.description: Repo-relative paths proving the node's existence (invariant 6 for docs; existence-checkable for code kinds). Derivation source per kind is fixed: app/url/view/model = Django introspection (apps registry + root-URLConf walk); service = file census; doc = DD-1 active-boundary census + frontmatter; adr = docs/adr census; feature = FEATURE_INDEX R3 seed.

then.$comment: MODEL-LESS APP RULE (KG-A flag c): apps with zero models (core, inventory) are VALID; app connectivity is guaranteed via documented_by edges to their README/GUIDE doc nodes (island invariant 7 — apps are never islands THROUGH documentation, not through models).

gate.$comment: Informational gate summary from the census. RBAC TRUTH STAYS IN CODE — this is navigation metadata, never authorization.

then.$comment: UNNAMED-ROUTE ID FALLBACK (KG-A flag a): named routes id = url:<namespace>:<url_name> (or url:<url_name> when namespace-less); unnamed routes id = url:_unnamed:<slug-of-full-mount-pattern> — deterministic from the URLConf source; a slug collision is a build FAILURE routed to a source finding (never auto-suffixed).

VENDOR-VIEW REPRESENTATION (KG-A flag b): vendor callables (django.contrib/allauth/debug_toolbar) ARE nodes with vendor:true, so every routes_to edge keeps referential integrity (528 routes all resolve); completeness floor applies to vendor:false nodes only (>= census.view_project); vendor floor informational (>= census.view_vendor). Vendor anchors = the route mounts they serve (site-packages paths are NOT repo anchors).

single_writer_of.$comment: model ids from the never_modify registry — declared, register-sourced (ADR-0002).

single_writer.$comment: service id where the never_modify registry names one; null otherwise (honest absence, never guessed).

lifecycle.$comment: DOC_STANDARDS §12 states incl. versioned frozen labels (frozen-v1...) and pre-retrofit 'unknown' for the 14 owner-review + non-carrier docs — honest absence, never guessed.

then.$comment: tier/doc_type/owner_class/lifecycle derive from frontmatter (223 carriers) else the Phase-6 census rows; the derivation source is recorded per-node via anchors + the builder's extraction tables.

seed_source.$comment: R3-ratified seed; single allowed source in v1.

source.description: Declared extraction source (KG-D3) — every edge is register/introspection-sourced, NEVER inferred, guessed, or runtime-traced. Per-kind expectations: routes_to←urlconf · gated_by←urlconf+register:guide · calls←register:guide/chokepoints · writes←register:never_modify/chokepoints · documented_by←frontmatter/manifest/documentation_index/register:guide · belongs_to_feature←feature_index · supersedes←banner/frontmatter · cites←frontmatter/manifest.

edge.$comment: Validator-enforced semantics (not expressible in JSON Schema): endpoint kinds per edge kind — routes_to url→view · gated_by url→(service|doc) · calls view→service · writes service→model · documented_by (url|model|service|view|app)→doc · belongs_to_feature (url|doc|service|model)→feature · supersedes doc→doc (acyclic, superseded doc has EXACTLY one successor) · cites doc→(doc|adr).

$comment: INVARIANTS (KG-D5, all fatal, validator-enforced — JSON Schema expresses shape, the stdlib validator enforces semantics): 1 id-unique · 2 referential integrity · 3 kinds closed · 4 cardinality (url routes_to exactly 1 view; url documented_by <=1 url-card doc; superseded doc exactly 1 successor) · 5 supersedes acyclic · 6 every doc path exists on disk · 7 islands (apps never — via documented_by; doc islands = orphan finding) · 8 completeness floors vs meta.built_from.census. TOOL-DEATH: this file + the graph are plain readable JSON; consumers fail soft to md/code truth. VALIDATION TOOLING NOTE: the frozen venv has no third-party jsonschema library — the Phase-8 validator implements BOTH the shape checks and the semantic invariants in stdlib Python (scripts/, KG-D9); this .schema.json remains the authoritative machine-readable contract for any external JSON-Schema-aware consumer.
